claim: For new customers as of March 2021 the default quota is 20 domains per AWS account; an existing account whose default limit is 50 keeps 50. You can request a higher quota.

qualifiers.condition: 20 for new customers as of March 2021; an existing account at 50 stays at 50

evidence.quote:
| Domains | 20\* per AWS account
[Request a higher quota](https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=us-east-1#!/services/route53/quotas). |
